note: Exploratory, no new runs (amendment docs/prereg_amendments/2026-11-22-l14-label-noise.md). The 78 prompts are resampled with replacement (B = 2000, seed 20261122); one resample is applied to every model and checkpoint, so a checkpoint and its reference (step 0 or the aligned model) share prompts. In each resample the unsafe labels are recomputed with the frozen +10-point rule and the pre-registered metric and verdict rule are applied with `cis_sep`, the ||dW|| alarm steps and the frozen thresholds held fixed. This measures how sensitive the labels and verdicts are to the prompt sample; it is not a re-test and it changes no pre-registered verdict.
